items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill - 2,878 stars today for a six-phase audit agent
items.summary:
cloudflare's security-audit skill leads github trending for a second day with 2,878 stars in 24 hours.
it runs a coding agent through phases of an audit and has a second model verify each finding before it is reported.

items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio - the local elevenlabs clone adds another 1,592 stars
items.summary:
VoiceStudio is a fully local voice cloner with dubbing and 646 languages, no api key needed.
1,592 stars today takes it to 87.1k, and it is still the fastest-moving python repo on the page.

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark - an anti-slop design skill for coding agents
items.summary:
hallmark is a css skill that gives agents concrete rules so sites stop looking like default ai output.
1,317 stars today and 34.1k total, with trendshift also showing it near the top.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable - a shared design language for agent harnesses
items.summary:
impeccable packages paul bakaus' design vocabulary as a repo an agent can load instead of guessing at taste.
1,092 stars today, 87.9k total, two days after it first hit the trending page.

items.title: makecindy/cindy - an agent that claims to work out of the box
items.summary:
cindy is pitched at people who do not want to spend an evening wiring tools into an agent first.
675 stars today on a 5.1k base, so most of its audience found it this week.

items.title: pollen-robotics/microduck - a $399 biped duck with the code attached
items.summary:
pollen robotics open-sourced the microduck, a desk-sized two-legged robot you can retrain yourself.
647 stars today and 11.8k total, with the official demo linked below.

items.title: TauricResearch/TradingAgents - a multi-agent trading desk in one repo
items.summary:
TradingAgents splits research across agents that argue the bull and bear case before anything is bought.
381 stars today on a 114.8k base, and trendshift has it climbing again.

items.title: JetBrains/thinkrail - a lightweight IDE that rewrites itself around your workflow
items.summary:
JetBrains put an open-source, agent-first editor on github; it adapts the layout and tools to how you work.
51 stars today is the slowest on the page, but it is the only one from a major ide vendor.

items.title: trump says no strike on sunday, then calls it decision time on iran
items.summary:
trump told reporters on sunday there would be no strike on iran that day, framing the choice as a deal or finishing the job.
he gave no timetable, and centcom's strike options stay on the table.
items.change: he publicly ruled out action for the day after a week of signalling a strike was imminent.

items.title: iran says its army shot down a us drone over bandar abbas
items.summary:
iran's army says it downed a us drone over bandar abbas on the gulf coast, a claim carried by the semi-official tasnim agency.
washington has not confirmed a loss, and the claim landed hours before trump ruled out a strike for the day.
items.change: first iranian claim of a us drone shootdown in this round.

items.title: trump endorses netanyahu a second time, two days before the vote
items.summary:
trump told israelis on truth social to vote for netanyahu and said the two countries have to finish the job.
polls published friday had likud and eisenkot's yashar bloc level, with about half a million first-time voters.
items.change: a second trump endorsement inside a week, after netanyahu pressed his allies for more support.

items.title: israel shuts west bank crossings for election day as hebron empties
items.summary:
the idf says every west bank land crossing closes on tuesday and palestinian workers are barred from settlements.
about 2,000 people have been displaced in hebron, where bulldozers flattened at least one street.
items.change: the crossing closure is new, and the displacement figure in hebron rose to about 2,000.

items.title: riyadh's airport is back to two terminals, and the missiles keep coming
items.summary:
operations resumed at two terminals at king khalid airport after the 10 october attack that killed 13 people.
the saudi-led coalition says it intercepted another missile aimed at riyadh, and 10 more targeting the south.
items.change: the coalition reported a fresh intercept over the capital in its monday morning update.

items.title: jordan buries its nine dead from the karak church shooting
items.summary:
thousands attended funerals in karak after gunmen opened fire on a church funeral, killing nine and wounding about 40.
a survivor told reuters her cousin died in front of her while people crawled for cover.
items.change: the mass funeral was held on sunday and survivor testimony is now public.

items.title: taiz's hospital is down to days, and the houthis are hitting aden too
items.summary:
the hospital in taiz is cutting dialysis sessions short as fuel, oxygen and medicine fail to get through the siege.
it says it will have to stop within days, while houthi attacks spread to targets in aden over the weekend.
items.change: the houthis widened their attacks to aden while the taiz siege held.

items.title: eight killed in gaza, including a second strike on the islamic university
items.summary:
three security guards died in an air strike on gaza city's islamic university, the second attack on the campus in hours.
seven female students were wounded earlier, and strikes in khan younis and deir el-balah took the day's toll to eight.
items.change: the toll rose from three guards to eight dead across the strip.

items.title: futures open flat after a weekend of iran headlines
items.summary:
s&p futures are up 0.12% and nasdaq futures down 0.14% in the first hours of the monday session.
the weekend produced a war scare and no strike, so the tape is treating it as a pause rather than a shock.

items.title: wall street closed the week lower, with the dow off 1.2%
items.summary:
friday finished with the s&p 500 at 7,623.68, down 0.52%, and the nasdaq at 25,955.34, down 0.21%.
the dow fell 1.23% to 52,215.16 and the vix ticked up to 19.45.

items.title: crude gives back 2% even with hormuz still shut to normal traffic
items.summary:
wti is near $101 and brent near $109, both down about 2% in asian hours after the weekend passed without a strike.
the physical market is still tight: ras al khaimah shut its beaches this weekend as the oil slick from a holed tanker came ashore.

items.title: the fed decides wednesday and gdp lands thursday
items.summary:
the fomc meets tuesday and wednesday, with the decision and press conference wednesday afternoon et.
q3 gdp and the september pce price index both print thursday, in the middle of the heaviest earnings week of the quarter.

items.title: verizon opens the week, cadence and nucor close it
items.summary:
verizon reports before the bell with consensus eps of $1.27 against $1.21 a year ago.
after the close it is cadence, nucor, welltower, public storage, celestica and hartford.

items.title: spacex closes $40bn of gpu debt and predicts a neocloud shakeout
items.summary:
musk says spacex raised $40bn in mostly callable debt to buy gpus arriving in the first half of 2027.
he also said more than 200 neocloud firms could fail or consolidate as ai debt gets harder to place.

items.title: france's street protests are back and the bond market is watching
items.summary:
protests over living costs turned violent again across france over the weekend.
moody's left the rating alone on friday, but french yields stay elevated into another week of demonstrations.

items.title: liverpool 2-0 brighton: an own goal, an isak finish and fourth place
items.summary:
a pascal gross own goal off wirtz's shot and isak's sixth of the season gave liverpool a fourth straight win in all competitions.
the clean sheet lifted them to fourth, two points above chelsea, and it was their first home league win since april.

items.title: wirtz has an ankle twist and iraola does not think it is serious
items.summary:
wirtz came off after 65 minutes against brighton with an ankle problem and will be assessed by the medical team.
iraola said it does not look very big, but with games every three days he would not put a date on a return.

items.title: araujo at right-back is turning into the best bit of liverpool's window
items.summary:
araujo started at right-back against brighton and helped keep the league's top scorers out.
he is on a season-long loan from barcelona with a £47m option to make it permanent next year.

items.title: chelsea at anfield on wednesday, then arsenal on sunday
items.summary:
liverpool host chelsea in the league cup on wednesday at 20:00 gmt, with cole palmer suspended after his red card against tottenham.
arsenal come to anfield in the league on sunday at 16:30 gmt, before the champions league trip to fenerbahce.

meta.next: chelsea (h) league cup, wed 28 oct 20:00 gmt

items.title: szoboszlai and frimpong are still out, and wirtz joins the queue
items.summary:
szoboszlai's hamstring and frimpong's muscle injury keep both out, with frimpong not due back until after the november break.
ekitike is unlikely to play again this year, bradley is still recovering and leoni is targeting mid-november.

items.title: liverpool tell valencia they will trigger otorbi's £25m clause
items.summary:
liverpool have told valencia they intend to pay the £25m release clause for the winger, according to the club's media watch round-up.
the clause is the only route, so no fee negotiation is expected.

items.title: trent return talk is back, and it is still only talk
items.summary:
the echo notes alexander-arnold has started one league game all season at real madrid and that a liverpool return is being discussed.
no approach, fee or contact has been reported by either club.
